stances_toward.note: Prime Minister Fico is the second veto player on the road to the EU: he cut emergency electricity to Ukraine in February 2026 and threatened to block the 20th sanctions package and slow accession over the Druzhba oil outage, then said on 22 Apr 2026 that he would stop objecting to the EUR 90bn loan since the pipeline was working again. Bratislava also lost Russian gas transit when the contract with Naftogaz expired on 1 Jan 2025. Rival, not partner: Slovakia uses its vote as a weapon against Kyiv; our reading, confidence C. Bond - none.
